packageRules.description: @types/node follows the Node that runs the app (22 in production, 24 in CI): no types of a newer major, they would let APIs through that production does not have

Sentry 11 sends request bodies, cookies and headers by default unless dataCollection is set, drops import-in-the-middle and changes the build instrumentation: a migration of its own, to validate on staging with the real DSN
c15t 3 is a rewrite (12 October 2026) that no longer blocks third-party requests such as Google Analytics before consent: to take together with a decision on how GA is gated
TanStack Table 9 changes the table API (hook, row models, state): the three admin lists need a migration of their own
